question: Tiger and Disha have to travel from Delhi to Kanpur in their respective cars. Tiger is driving at 100 km/hr while Disha is driving at 35 km/hr. Find the time taken by Disha to reach Kanpur if Tiger takes 14 hours.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time.

Ratio of speeds (Tiger : Disha) = 100 : 35 = 20 : 7

Ratio of time taken = 7 : 20

Tiger's time = 7 units = 14 hours ⇒ 1 unit = 2 hours

Disha's time = 20 units = 20 × 2 = 40 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 40 hours.**
